title: Existence of universally normalized internal scalar pullback comparisons
statement: For any morphism a of commutative condensed rings and scheme morphism f:X→Y, there exists b:D(a,Y)⋙L(S,f)≅L(R,f)⋙D(a,X) satisfying PullNormalized a f b, with the specified ordinary pullIso and universal computation counits from [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. No flatness or boundedness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Paragraph (1), reduction comparison in the specified coefficient category; extracted old step 2. Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0G7E (lemma-pullback-K-flat), 0D6D (lemma-derived-pullback-composition), 07A6 (lemma-adjoint).

proof.text: Form the counits of the two composite functors by whiskering and composing the scalar and geometric counits. Exact geometric pullback has invertible counit on every homotopy complex. The scalar counit is invertible on K-flat complexes. Geometric pullback preserves K-flatness: its first factor is monoidal inverse image on module objects, and extension along the pulled-back coefficient isomorphism is an equivalence. Thus both composite counits are invertible on the K-flat resolving subcategory. The left-derivability-structure criterion makes both composites universal left-derived functors.

Apply leftDerivedNatIso to the homotopy comparison induced by pullIso.symm. The defining leftDerivedNatTrans_app equality is exactly PullNormalized, after expanding associators and whiskering. This constructs the comparison independently of section transport.
